title: ClanBossState
description: Current HP state for each boss in the active clan battle.

source.description: The source of the clan data, either from Discord or web.

clanid.description: The unique ID of the clan.

yearmonth.description: The year and month in YYYYMM format.

current_hp.description: The remaining HP for the current boss.

max_hp.description: The maximum HP for the boss, used as the baseline for the current battle state.

is_defeated.description: Whether the boss has been defeated.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the boss state was last updated.

updated_by.description: The user or system that last updated the boss state.
